name: Coup de Grâce
description:
Trigger: You win an engagement and it is at least the third consecutive engagement you've won against the same creature this combat.

The next time you hit the creature with an attack this turn, +1d damage and the creature rolls Injury. If the creature is prone, gain an additional +1d damage. If you roll 🌞 on the attack roll, the creature rolls Injury twice.

Describe your killing blow.
